g.text: The same potential-outcome marginals do not fix individual effects
Each Y(0) and Y(1) marginal has P(0)=P(1)=0.5 in both couplings.
Both ATE values are 0; the individual-effect distributions differ.
Top cells specify the within-unit joint pairing.
